mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id , i.user_id , i.title , i.`status` , u.locale AS user_locale , m.message_id AS msg_message_id , m.inquiry_id AS msg_inquiry_id , m.seq AS msg_seq , m.sender_type AS msg_sender_type , m.body AS msg_body FROM ( SELECT inquiry_id, user_id, title, `status`, created_at FROM t_inquiry WHERE `status` = '00' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) i INNER JOIN m_user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_inquiry_message m ON i.inquiry_id = m.inquiry_id ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, m.seq ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inquiry_message ( inquiry_id, seq, sender_type, body, create_user_id, create_program, created_at, update_user_id, update_program, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{message.inquiryId.value}, #{message.seq}, #{message.senderType.code}, #{message.body}, #{operatorUserId}, #{program}, NOW(6), #{operatorUserId}, #{program}, NOW(6) )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_inquiry SET status = #{status}, update_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, update_program = #{program}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
